slides.content:
How to Pass Front-End II

UDIT 2026-27 · Grado en Desarrollo Full-Stack / Data-Science & AI

Rubén Vega Balbás, PhD · ruvebal@crea-comm.net

6 ECTS · 150h total · 30h laboratory · Semester

Course Information

Academic Year2026-27
SemesterSemester 2 (annual course)
ECTS6
InstructorRubén Vega Balbás, PhD
Emailruvebal@crea-comm.net

This document details the deliverables, evaluation tests, and requirements to successfully complete Front-End II. Delivery dates may vary from the indicative dates shown here.

Evaluation Structure

ComponentWeight
Pruebas (Tests)30%
Trabajos, entregables y proyectos (Projects)50%
Portafolio (Problem-solving portfolio)20%

Total: 100% · Pass threshold: 5.0 average

Selected within official range: Pruebas 30–50% / Trabajos 40–60% / Portafolio 10–20%

Deliverable 1: Astro Architectural Project

NameEntrega 1 — Astro Architecture (Units 2-6)
DescriptionAstro project with content collections, islands architecture, multi-framework integration, testing strategy, and CI/CD
Indicative DateWeek 7 (October 2026)
% Evaluation20%
RequirementsComplete Astro setup, testing suite (Vitest + RTL + Playwright), and AI-assisted code review workflow

Deliverable 2: 3D Interface & IoT Control Panel

NameEntrega 2 — 3D/IoT Integration (Units 8-10)
DescriptionR3F 3D interface with shader effects + IoT/robotics control panel consuming Python-backed WebSocket service
Indicative DateWeek 11 (November 2026)
% Evaluation20%
RequirementsR3F interactive 3D components, custom GLSL shaders, WebSocket real-time data, Python FastAPI backend

Deliverable 3: Capstone Project & Oral Defence

NameEntrega 3 / Examen Final — Capstone (Units 11-12)
DescriptionCapstone project integration with process evidence, AI use declaration, and oral defence presentation
Indicative DateFinal exam period (December 2026)
% Evaluation10%
RequirementsComplete process evidence (decisions.md, iterations.md, AI_USE_DECLARATION.md), verify/narrate axes, 15-minute oral defence

Test 1: Mid-Term Examination

NameMid-Term Written Test
DescriptionTheory and practical skills covering units 1-7 (Astro, PWA, testing, performance)
Indicative DateWeek 7 (October 2026)
% Evaluation15%
RequirementsNo prerequisite · Covers sessions U1-U7

Test 2: Final Examination

NameFinal Written Test
DescriptionTheory and practical skills covering full curriculum (3D, IoT, capstone concepts)
Indicative DateFinal exam period (December 2026)
% Evaluation15%
RequirementsMust present Deliverables 1, 2, and 3 previously

Portfolio Component

NameProblem-Solving Portfolio
DescriptionResolution of exercises, problem-solving evidence, session reflections, and process documentation
Indicative DateContinuous throughout the semester
% Evaluation20%
RequirementsCommit evidence per session with ATELIER reflections, decision logs, and iteration documentation

Ordinary Evaluation Criteria

  • The average of all evaluated components must reach 5.0 for the subject to be considered approved.
  • If any deliverable or test scores below 4.5, the subject will be suspended, and the student must present to the extraordinary evaluation.
  • All components must be completed to calculate the final average.

Extraordinary Evaluation

  • Students who fail the ordinary evaluation may present to the extraordinary evaluation.
  • Conditions: Must complete failed deliverables (1, 2, or 3) and/or retake failed tests (mid-term, final).
  • Type of test: Written examination covering failed content areas.
  • Portfolio evidence may be requested for review.

Important Notes

  • AI Disclosure: All AI-assisted work must follow the docs-first methodology with documented plans and implementation reports. See AI Use Declaration Rubric.
  • Oral Defence: Units 11-12 require a 15-minute presentation with diff walkthrough and Q&A. See Oral Defence Rubric.
  • Process Evidence: All capstone projects must include decisions.md, iterations.md, and AI_USE_DECLARATION.md.
  • Phase 5 Dependency: Unit 10 IoT data source will be defined in Back-End II synergy sheet; placeholder until then.

Key Dates Summary

  • October 2026: Mid-Term Test (15%) + Entrega 1 (20%)
  • November 2026: Entrega 2 (20%)
  • December 2026: Final Test (15%) + Entrega 3 / Oral Defence (10%)
  • Continuous: Problem-Solving Portfolio (20%)
